Scott International Jacket Thermowrap — Men’s Customizable Jacket with Logo or Text

Scott International Jacket Thermowrap brings premium warmth and professional branding together. Built for comfort and durability, this men’s Thermowrap is ideal for corporate gifts, team uniforms, outdoor events, and promotional apparel. Customize the with your logo or text using embroidery or high-quality heat-transfer printing.

Why choose?

  • Thermal Performance: Insulated lining retains body heat for cold-weather comfort.
  • Weather Protection: Windproof outer shell and water-resistant finish keep you dry.
  • Custom Branding: Add your logo or text on chest, sleeve, or back — perfect for corporate uniforms and giveaways.
  • Premium Fit: Tailored men’s cut with adjustable cuffs and hem for a modern look.
  • Durability: Reinforced stitching and quality zippers for long-lasting wear.

Benefits for businesses & buyers

Brand your team with confidence — the offers visible, high-quality customization that strengthens brand recognition. Bulk pricing makes it economical for employee kits, conference giveaways, and branded merchandise. Local pickup or nationwide shipping available.
